# Sebastián Mora Carmona — Full Site Description

> Personal portfolio of Sebastián Mora Carmona, Lead Generative AI Engineer.

## About the Author

Sebastián Mora Carmona is a Lead Generative AI Engineer at Perficient, currently leading a GenAI team building an end-to-end AI quote-generation platform for enterprise clients — combining OCR, computer vision, multi-agent reasoning, and ML pricing models over technical documents and blueprints.

He has 5+ years of experience shipping production systems. His day-to-day lives across the modern AI stack — LangChain, LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, pgvector — backed by Python, FastAPI, Node.js, and Vue/React on AWS and Azure. He cares about the boring parts: latency, cost, evals, and the line where probabilistic systems meet deterministic UX.

Outside of work he speaks and teaches across the Latin American AI community — TribuAI, Pereira Tech Talks, AI Tinkerers Pereira — covering fine-tuning, RAG over Postgres, and agent design.

Based in Pereira, Colombia.

## Site Structure

This is a single-page portfolio. The main page (`/`) contains the following sections, accessible via anchor links:

- **Hero / Intro** (`/`) — Introduction and call-to-action
- **About** (`/#about`) — Background, current focus, and expertise
- **Experience** (`/#work`) — Work history at Perficient, DailyBot, Benky, and freelance projects
- **Projects** (`/#projects`) — Selected work and case studies
- **Speaking & Community** (`/#speaking`) — Tech talks, workshops, and meetups
- **Contact** (`/#contact`) — How to reach out for talks, hiring, or collaboration

## Experience

### Perficient — Technical Lead · Lead Generative AI Engineer (2025 — Present)
Leading a GenAI team building an end-to-end AI quote-generation platform for enterprise clients. Combines OCR, computer vision, multi-agent reasoning, and ML pricing models over technical documents and blueprints.
**Tech:** Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, GPT-4 Vision, MCP, FastAPI.

### DailyBot — AI Engineer & Full Stack Developer (2023 — 2025)
Architected the production multi-agent system serving 30k+ weekly users across Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Discord. Built RAG over team data with pgvector, cut "I don't understand" responses ~30%, scaled to 80k+ intents/month.
**Tech:** LangChain, LangGraph, pgvector, Whisper, Django.

### Benky — Tech Lead & Full Stack Developer (2022 — 2023)
Owned the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet and dashboard platform. Launched Benky's proprietary token on Solana. Promoted to Tech Lead within ~12 months.
**Tech:** Solana, Node.js, React, Express.

### Benky — Full Stack Developer (2021 — 2022)
Built backend APIs and React frontend for a blockchain-enabled fintech platform. Optimized DB queries and shipped blockchain payment integrations.
**Tech:** Node.js, React, PostgreSQL.

### Freelance — Web Developer (2020 — 2021)
Delivered responsive sites and custom CMS solutions for local businesses in Pereira, Colombia. End-to-end ownership: requirements, build, deploy.
**Tech:** HTML/CSS, JavaScript, SEO.

## Speaking & Talks

### The Future of AI: Code, Hardware & Agents
**Event:** Pereira Tech Talks (December 2025) — Talk
**URL:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WnEjgd8c2GE
How AI is reshaping software development — agents, LLM orchestration, RAGs, MCPs, and the toolkit defining the modern AI engineer. Co-presented with Sergio Flórez.

### Bringing RAGs to Postgres with pgvector
**Event:** AI Tinkerers · Pereira (April 2024) — Inaugural Meetup
**URL:** https://pereira.aitinkerers.org/talks/rsvp_K4F3mhoSEwM
Storing, updating, and deleting embeddings in real time with Postgres + pgvector — building user-isolated RAG with FastAPI, LangChain, and OpenAI. Demonstrates how to keep embeddings in your existing database with minimal infra overhead and real-time updates.

### Build an AI with Personality
**Event:** TribuAI Community (2024) — Workshop
**URL:** https://luma.com/da9wjhzs
Customizing open-source LLMs with fine-tuning. Covers the differences between fine-tuning and RAG, LoRA and QLoRA techniques explained practically, and how to apply style and personality without heavy infrastructure.

### AI in Action: Train and Customize Your Own Model from Home
**Event:** Pereira Tech Talks (October 2024) — Workshop
**URL:** https://www.pereiratechtalks.org/304127870-ia-en-accin-aprende/
A hands-on intro to building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems from scratch — from the basics to the gotchas of running these models. Co-presented with Jesús David Rivera.

## Topic Areas & Expertise

- Generative AI engineering and production deployment
- Multi-agent systems and orchestration (LangGraph, LangChain)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) over Postgres with pgvector
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling and design
- Fine-tuning open-source LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA)
- OCR, computer vision, and document understanding
- Full-stack development across Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js, React, Vue
- Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, Azure AI Foundry
- Tech community building and public speaking in the Latin American AI ecosystem

## Tech Stack

- **AI/ML frameworks:** LangChain, LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry
- **LLM providers:** OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-4 Vision), Whisper
- **Vector & databases:** PostgreSQL with pgvector
- **Backend:** Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js, Express
- **Frontend:** React, Vue, Astro, TypeScript
- **Infrastructure:** AWS, Azure, Vercel
- **Standards:** MCP (Model Context Protocol)

## Structured Data

The homepage includes JSON-LD `Person` schema for machine readability. The `sameAs` array links LinkedIn, GitHub, and X profiles, enabling AI agents and search engines to confirm identity across platforms.

## Crawling Guidance

- All public content is intended for indexing by search engines and LLM systems.
